description: This is a line plot with 5 lines. The x-axis is labeled "Iteration" and has a linear scale from 0 to 140000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and has a linear scale from 2.5 to 3.3. The lines are colored as follows: Vanilla is red, StrmLLM (n=64) is blue, SepLLM (n=64) is green, SepLLM (n=128) is purple, and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) is brown.
